FVA resolves this by fixing the objective at $Z \ge \gamma Z^*$ (e.g., $\gamma = 1.0$ or $0.99$) and sequentially minimizing and maximizing each individual reaction flux $v_i$ across the network to determine its full feasible range $[v_i^{\min}, v_i^{\max}]$.
